revision_policy: GDP is revision-prone. Historical annual observations retain their source vintage; preliminary observations are replaced by the latest official vintage when a newer QE or annual estimate becomes available. Do not compare two vintages as if they were economic change.
rule: Macro is context, not a logistics signal by itself. Promote it only when a transmission channel to trade, physical flow, cost or demand is supported.
revision_policy_ja: GDPは改定されるため、速報値は最新公表値へ更新し、過去年次は出典vintageを保持する。vintage差を景気変化として扱わない。
rule_ja: マクロ経済は単独で物流シグナルに昇格させず、貿易・物量・コスト・需要への伝播経路が確認できる場合に使う。
